title: Lower Bound for Appended-Event Probability
statement: Let $m_1,m_2$ be natural numbers, let $A$ be a decidable property of Boolean lists, and let $C(u,v)$ be a decidable property of pairs of Boolean lists. Write $P_k(D)$ for the fraction of Boolean lists of length $k$ satisfying a property $D$. Suppose that for every Boolean string $u$ of length $m_1$ satisfying $A$, the probability that an independent uniform Boolean string $v$ of length $m_2$ satisfies $C(u,v)$ is at least $\varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is rational. Then the probability that a uniform Boolean string $r$ of length $m_1+m_2$ satisfies $C(r_{\le m_1},r_{>m_1})$ is at least $P_{m_1}(A)\varepsilon$.
